# Pitex 1.1.3

Open Project says why a folder cannot be opened. SyncTeX is ready when
you open a .tex file whose PDF is already compiled.

## Changes

- Open Project no longer fails with an opaque "error 1". When macOS
  rejects the security-scoped bookmark because the app changed on disk
  (OSStatus -67034), Pitex tells you to quit and reopen Pitex, then open
  the project again. A folder that cannot be read tells you to choose
  the folder again with Open.
- SyncTeX works when you open a .tex file whose PDF was already
  compiled. Pitex binds a matching SyncTeX companion. When no companion
  matches, Pitex runs one compile and leaves the PDF on screen.

## Install

Pitex 1.0.0 through 1.1.2 update to 1.1.3 from Settings or, with automatic
installation enabled, at launch. For Homebrew installations, run
`brew update` and `brew upgrade --cask pitex`.

Builds from the earlier 2.x line do not update automatically; install 1.1.3
from the downloads below. Pitex Nightly continues to use its separate
update channel.

## Downloads

Downloads include the macOS ARM64 DMG, Ubuntu 22.04 and 24.04 AMD64 DEBs,
Windows AMD64 installer and portable ZIP, the Ubuntu installer, and
SHA256SUMS.
Windows remains beta.
